info.name: design-agent
info.description:
Design-agent chatbot — Q&A over extracted storefront layouts (RAG + Claude tool-calling).

Auth: requests are guarded by SessionAuthGuard, which delegates to api-core's /auth/verify-session using the forwarded cookies. Log in via the api-core collection first so the owner session cookie is set, or set DESIGN_AGENT_AUTH_DISABLED=true on the service for local testing.
